mapper.sql: id, admin_id, admin_name, email, password_hash, department, group_names, service_expires_at, last_login_at, status, registrant, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_name FROM admin_role ar JOIN role r ON r.id = ar.role_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId}

where.if: AND (a.admin_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.admin_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.admin_id, a.admin_name, a.email, a.password_hash, a.department, a.group_names, a.service_expires_at, a.last_login_at, a.status, a.registrant, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM admin a
ORDER BY a.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin (admin_id, admin_name, email, password_hash, department, status, registrant) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{adminName}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{department}, #{status}, #{registrant})
mapper.update: UPDATE admin SET admin_name = #{adminName}, email = #{email}, department = #{department}, status = #{status}, registrant = #{registrant}, group_names = #{groupNames}, service_expires_at = #{serviceExpiresAt} WHERE id = #{id}
